item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `compiled = optimizer.compile(Student(), ...)` and performs all inspection on `compiled.predictor...`, not on the original student instance."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"The deterministic `DummyLM` proposes a new instruction, and the answer proves that proposal appears on the compiled predictor’s signature/prompt text, showing COPRO applied it to the predictor rather than only storing scores elsewhere."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Takes `compiled.predictor.predict.signature` as the proof target and reads the final `instructions` from that compiled predictor."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Prints the optimized instruction and rendered system message from the compiled signature, then asserts the proposed instruction exactly matches and is present in the rendered prompt."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"The check is framed around the compiled predictor’s final signature object, consistent with `with_instructions` producing a new signature carrying the updated instructions rather than mutating the original in place."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
